87:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(He seems quite worn out. As I thought, $$ランド$$ is being tossed about by a Reactor's fate too.)

87:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The clash of the $$傷だらけの獅子$$ and the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$... That collision produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. Of course, I've added them to the stock, but...)

87:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The Reactors are gradually being gathered... When they are all gathered, what on earth will happen...)

87:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(It may well turn out to be the worst possible outcome for every world, you know...)

87:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Pleased to meet you, $$メール$$. I am AG, the agent robot of $$ＤＥＭ$$.」

87:t_10:29.en:
$$メール$$
「Pleased to meet you, Mr. AG. I'm $$メール・ビーター$$, sales rep for the wandering repair shop, $$ビーター・サービス$$.」

87:t_10:30.en:
$$メール$$
「If Mr. AG's body is ever out of order, our skilled craftsmen will handle the repairs with sincerity and a smile.」

87:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「N-No, thank you. If I took a hit from $$ランド$$'s Heat Smile, my oil would boil over.」

87:t_10:32.en:
$$メール$$
「You mean you're totally smitten with Darling's charm?!」

87:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...$$ランド$$ and $$メール$$ are a fine match, I must say.」

87:t_10:34.en:
$$メール$$
「Thanks, AG. I think we're going to get along just fine.」

87:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If a sharp sales girl like $$メール$$ helps out at the $$Ｄトレーダー$$, it's a great help to me as well.」

87:t_10:36.en:
$$メール$$
「Got it. I'll mind the shop for you in my spare time.」

87:t_10:37.en:
$$メール$$
「Well then, let's get right to it...! Let's give it our all again today...!」

87:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... having someone else do the swinging feels this wonderful... I... never knew.」

88:t_000:1.en:
$$ラム$$
「The Resistance units in the area are drawing off the enemy's interception force.」

88:t_000:3.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「All that's left is to bring down $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

88:t_000:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...No, it's nothing. Deploy all units.」

88:t_000:10.en:
$$アルト$$
「You sortied at the head of the pack because you've got something in mind, right?」

88:t_000:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「No use hiding it. Lately, whatever you're thinking shows on your face.」

88:t_000:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「We've known each other a long time. It's no surprise.」

88:t_000:14.en:
$$アルト$$
「I don't know what you're planning, but you could rely on us a little, you know.」

88:t_000:15.en:
$n
「Sorry... I can't explain what I'm feeling myself very well either.」

88:t_000:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's fine. We're all in the same $c, after all.」

88:t_000:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「Your fight is our fight. All of us will share your worries.」

88:t_000:19.en:
$$スズネ$$
「At a time like this, you should say thank you, not sorry.」

88:t_000:21.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's go, $n, everyone. To save the $$アメリア$$ Continent and $$翠の地球$$.」

88:t_000:24.en:
$$ルカ$$
「An interception force is coming from $$セントラル・ベース$$!」

88:t_001:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$c...! So you came after all!」

88:t_001:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「It's the decisive battle and we still get the same old opponent.」

88:t_001:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh heh heh... Can you still crack jokes like that after seeing this interception force?」

88:t_001:4.en:
$$クラン$$
「I expect it's the usual drones and mummy men...」

88:t_001:5.en:
$$カナリア$$
「$$ルカ$$, can you tell anything?」

88:t_001:6.en:
$$ルカ$$
「From my analysis of the $$アンゲロイ$$-type motion data, the pilots of those units appear to be $$インセクト$$s.」

88:t_001:9.en:
$$マオ$$
「I'm sure that was explained in the briefing. $$インセクト$$s are the artificial soldiers the $$サイデリアル$$ use.」

88:t_001:10.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Their base is Earth's insects, and they exploit the aggressiveness and cohesion those creatures have.」

88:t_001:11.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「They're something like suicide weapons specialized for attack. All units, be careful.」

88:t_001:12.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Geez! Using the nature of someone else's planet to do whatever they please!」

88:t_001:13.en:
$n
「And to turn even that into a weapon. This is the height of depravity.」

88:t_001:14.en:
$$甲児$$
「In that case, there's only one thing to do...!」

88:t_001:15.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm gonna smash you to pieces, $$サイデリアル$$!」

88:t_001:16.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Try it if you can! Don't underestimate this $$セントラル・ベース$$!」

88:t_001:19.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The enemy commander is more aggressive than ever before. Presume some tactical advantage exists.」

88:t_001:21.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Indeed, we met no great resistance when we broke through the defense line either...」

88:t_001:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「You mean we were lured in?」

88:t_001:23.en:
$$宗介$$
「But retreating from here would be even more dangerous.」

88:t_001:25.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That's right. Do not forget that we carry the hopes of many people.」

88:t_001:26.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$スカル$$ 1 to all units! First, we crush the head! Target the enemy ship and $$ギルター$$!」

88:t_001:28.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Come, $c! I'll turn this $$セントラル・ベース$$ into your gravestone!」

88:t_002:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「N-No...! At this rate, I'll...!」

88:t_002:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't worry, $$ギルター$$! It's not just you that's finished, it's this base too!」

88:t_002:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「And while we're at it, we'll knock every last $$サイデリアル$$ off $$翠の地球$$!」

88:t_002:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Y-You fools...! You should have just let me kill you!」

88:t_002:4.en:
$n
「No matter how stupid I am, I'm not stupid enough to pick that ending.」

88:t_002:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「In any case, we fall back here!」

88:t_003:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「N-No...! If I take any more time, I...」

88:t_003:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't worry, $$ギルター$$! Then we'll finish this right away!」
